description: This file contains functions related to Fortinet firmware upgrade process, including retrieving firmware info blocks and performing the upgrade by extracting files from an archive and writing to flash memory segments.

methods.name: fortinet_fwinfo_blocks
methods.description: Calculates and writes firmware info blocks to the specified offset for firmware upgrade procedures.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process by extracting firmware images from an archive, calculating their sizes, writing firmware info blocks, and flashing the kernel and root filesystem.
